{"code": "import numpy as np

# Check for missing values in the two variables of interest
print("Missing values in flipper_length_mm:", df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum())
print("Missing values in body_mass_g:", df['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum())

# Drop rows with missing values in either column for correlation
# (Pearson correlation requires complete pairs)
df_clean = df[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']].dropna()

# Compute Pearson correlation
correlation = df_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(df_clean['body_mass_g'])

# Output the result
print(f"Pearson correlation: {correlation:.4f}")"}
